false_alarm_budget.rationale: Alarms are read by a person. At ~250 sessions a year, alpha=0.01 is two to three alarms per instrument per year: rare enough to be worth opening, frequent enough not to miss a regime change for years. Chosen from review capacity, not from the resulting detection rate.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Assumes symmetry and a finite, well-estimated variance. Amihud illiquidity is right-skewed by construction (a ratio with turnover in the denominator), so a symmetric band is wrong on both sides at once.
Assume a normality that intraday variance and trade counts visibly do not have; the tail probability would be understated by orders of magnitude.
Is not a guarantee about anything.

rows.name: Anomaly alarm on realised variance
rows.how_defined: Empirical (1 - alpha) quantile of the calibration sample, taken at the conformal order statistic ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)). The n+1 accounts for the future observation, which is what makes the coverage statement a finite-sample guarantee under exchangeability rather than an asymptotic one.

rows.name: Operating threshold for the integrity-risk score
rows.method: selected on the training split, carried to evaluation unchanged
rows.how_defined: Chosen on the TRAINING split and read back from the experiment bundle. STATS-10 refuses to recompute it from the evaluation scores: choosing a threshold on the split you then report is threshold-provenance leakage (L6), and it would flatter every metric below it.

rows.name: Best-F1 threshold (error analysis only)
rows.method: argmax F1 over the precision-recall curve
rows.how_defined: The point on the precision-recall curve that maximises F1. Used by STATS-12 to bucket errors, and deliberately NOT used as the operating threshold: it is selected on the same scores it is then evaluated on.

rows.name: Count-event alarm band
rows.how_defined: lambda + z * sqrt(lambda) * sd_inflation, with z = 3.0. The inflation factor is the measured overdispersion of real trade counts; a Poisson band (inflation 1) was measured to be wrong and there is no fallback to it. Without the Week 2 result the detector raises MissingWeek2Input rather than guessing.

rows.name: Exposure gate band
rows.method: piecewise-linear cap on exposure as a function of integrity risk
rows.how_defined: Full allowance at or below risk 0.30, zero allowance at or above 0.80, linear in between, floored at 0.00. Uncertainty widens the effective risk by 0.50 x uncertainty, so an uncertain high reading is treated at least as cautiously as a confident one.
